title: Zero-Shot Distracted Driver Detection via Vision Language Models with Double Decoupling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the entanglement of driver identity factors (such as age, gender, and clothing) with behavior cues by visualizing the VLM embedding space via t-SNE (which showed clustering by driver identity rather than behavior class), and measuring classification performance (Top-1 Accuracy, Recall, Precision, AUPRC) on the SAM-DD dataset before and after applying Driver-specific Appearance Decoupling (DAD).

Qualitatively evaluated during the prompt engineering phase by observing the Vision-Language Model's asymmetric sensitivity to "left" versus "right" spatial cues, which was mitigated by removing unnecessary laterality words from the textual prompts.
